vibe: Warm, editorial, coastal, premium minimalist. No harsh neons, no purple/blue gradients.

typography.headings: Cormorant Garamond (Expressive, serif, tracking-tight for large text)
typography.rules: Keep existing photography-led minimalist-premium direction unchanged. Hierarchy: H1 max text-5xl/6xl, tight leading.

colors.description: Premium color system built from SurfKarnataka logo colors (sunset red/orange, warm gold) with a complementing deep ocean teal.

usage_rules.primary_buttons: Use sunset-red (--primary) for main CTAs. Ensures high visibility and warmth.
usage_rules.secondary_accents: Use warm-gold (--secondary) for highlights, active states, or secondary badges.
usage_rules.headings: In light theme, use deep ocean teal (--text) for high-contrast, premium typography. In dark theme, use warm off-white (--text).
usage_rules.dark_sections: Use charcoal-teal (--background in dark mode) as an anchor. Do not use pure black.
usage_rules.text: Never use pure white or pure black. Use sand-white / warm off-white for light text, and deep teal / charcoal-teal for dark text.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped or rounded-md. Hover states should slightly lift (-translate-y-0.5) and add a subtle shadow (shadow-lg) matching the button hue. Ensure text contrast.
components.active_nav_pill: Light theme: background surface/white with deep teal text, or warm-gold with dark text. Dark theme: background surface/112828 with warm off-white text.
components.theme_toggle: Add a prominent but tasteful light/dark theme toggle in the header. Use standard sun/moon icons (lucide-react).
components.whatsapp_button: Retain original WhatsApp green (#25D366). It stands outside the core brand palette but is necessary for conversion.

visual_enhancers.spacing: Generous spacing. p-8 to p-16 for section padding. Let the photography breathe.
visual_enhancers.borders: Delicate 1px borders using the --border variable. No heavy strokes.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Soft, diffuse ambient shadows for surfaces in light theme. In dark theme, use inner borders (border-white/10) instead of heavy shadows.

hero_background_dark.description: Dramatic evening sunset surf photograph with deep warm orange and red tones, surfer silhouette. Perfect for dark theme hero.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Always use the CSS variables defined in this document for colors to ensure the light/dark toggle works seamlessly.
All files are .js (not .tsx) - ensure valid JSX without TypeScript type annotations.
DO NOT use completely transparent backgrounds for headers or dropdowns. In light theme, use backdrop-blur with bg-white/70. In dark theme, use bg-[#0A1C1C]/80 with backdrop-blur.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (e.g. hover:scale-105, transition-all duration-300).
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='theme-toggle-button').
Ensure image constraints on mobile (e.g. max-h-[80vh]) to prevent viewport blocking.
Implement the theme toggle functionality globally using a React context or Zustand store, attaching a 'dark' class to the HTML/body element.
